title: Bounded models with projective terms are closed under extensions
statement: Let C be an abelian category with a derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let F be a class of objects of C invariant under isomorphisms, closed under binary biproducts, and consisting of projectives. In a distinguished triangle X to Y to Z to X[1], if X and Z have bounded cochain models all of whose terms satisfy F, then Y has such a bounded cochain model. No enough-projectives assumption on C is made.

proof.text: Choose bounded models P1 and P3 of the end objects. P3 is bounded above and termwise projective, hence K-projective. The connecting morphism Z to X[1], conjugated by the model isomorphisms and Q shift comparison, has a chain-map representative psi from P3 to P1[1] by [lem-pc-ring-derived-map-representative].

source.place: Tag 09C3 (lemma-local-structure-constructible-complex) final cone construction; derived.tex Tag 064B (lemma-morphisms-from-projective-complex)

proof.text: The mapping cone of psi is bounded: its terms are P3^(q+1) biproduct P1^(q+1), and both lower and upper bounds follow from those of P1 and P3. Its terms satisfy F by biproduct closure and invariance under the displayed term isomorphisms. Two rotations of the original triangle and the isomorphism-of-arrow criterion identify the cone with Y[1]. Shift the cone by -1, using the Q shift comparison and shift composition isomorphism, to obtain the required model of Y.

theorem bounded_projective_models_extensions
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} C]
    (F : C → Prop)
    (hiso : ∀ {X Y : C}, (X ≅ Y) → F X → F Y)
    (hbiprod : ∀ X Y : C, F X → F Y → F (X ⊞ Y))
    (hprojective : ∀ X : C, F X → Projective X)
    (T : Triangle (DerivedCategory C)) (hT : T ∈ distTriang _)
    (h₁ : ∃ (P : CochainComplex C ℤ) (a b : ℤ),
      P.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ P.IsStrictlyLE b ∧ (∀ i, F (P.X i)) ∧
      Nonempty (T.obj₁ ≅ Q.obj P))
    (h₃ : ∃ (P : CochainComplex C ℤ) (a b : ℤ),
      P.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ P.IsStrictlyLE b ∧ (∀ i, F (P.X i)) ∧
      Nonempty (T.obj₃ ≅ Q.obj P)) :
    ∃ (P : CochainComplex C ℤ) (a b : ℤ),
      P.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ P.IsStrictlyLE b ∧ (∀ i, F (P.X i)) ∧
      Nonempty (T.obj₂ ≅ Q.obj P)
